about.text: Pasteurised whole milk with its full fat, at least 3.5 % in the EU, chilled and keeping about a week unopened in the fridge. In Germany it is sold as Frischmilch, as against the longer-keeping ESL and UHT milks.

facts.v: Nýmjólk is the whole milk drunk there; milk drinking into adulthood is very common, and Mjólkursamsalan is the largest producer
Called 牛乳 (gyūnyū), with at least 3.0% fat. Most market milk is UHT, heated to 120–135 °C for 1–3 s; LL milk is aseptically packed and keeps about 3 months unopened
Sold as sữa tươi, pasteurised at about 75 °C for 30 s or 84–85 °C for 30–40 s; most of it is reportedly made from milk powder and keeps 7 to 10 days
